title: Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) — Settle-Up Terms Schedule
content:
# Settle-Up Terms Schedule — Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans)

The settle-up terms of each plan of Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans): when the deferred balance is settled, how a settle-up credit is released, the smallest credit refunded by check where checks apply, whether an anniversary settle-up debit may be spread and over how many bills, the days from the settle-up bill date to its due date, and the notice given before the anniversary bill.

## Terms

| Plan | When the deferred balance is settled | How a settle-up credit is released | Smallest credit refunded by check, where checks apply | Anniversary debit may be spread at the member's request | Bills over which a spread debit is billed | Days from settle-up bill date to due date | Days of notice before the anniversary bill |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Levelized Billing Rolling Average | continuous, no settle-up | applied to the next bill | $50.00 | No | 0 | 20 | 0 |
| Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up | anniversary month | applied to the next bill | $50.00 | Yes | 3 | 20 | 30 |
| Budget Billing Quarterly Review | anniversary month | applied to the next bill | $50.00 | Yes | 3 | 20 | 30 |
| Farm Budget Billing | anniversary month | applied to the next bill | $50.00 | Yes | 3 | 20 | 30 |
| Small Business Budget Billing | anniversary month | applied to the next bill | $50.00 | No | 0 | 20 | 30 |
| Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan | July bill | refunded by check when at least the minimum | $50.00 | No | 0 | 20 | 30 |

## Terms explained

1. **Settlement point.** Levelized Billing Rolling Average is continuous and has no settle-up. Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up, Budget Billing Quarterly Review, Farm Budget Billing and Small Business Budget Billing settle in the anniversary month. The Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan settles on the July bill.
2. **Credits.** On five plans a settle-up credit is applied to the next bill. On the Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan a settle-up credit is refunded by check when it is at least $50.00.
3. **Spreading an anniversary debit.** Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up, Budget Billing Quarterly Review and Farm Budget Billing allow an anniversary settle-up debit to be spread, at the member's request, over 3 bills. The other three plans do not allow it, and their spread figure is 0.
4. **Due date.** On every plan a settle-up bill is due 20 calendar days after its bill date.
5. **Notice.** The notice figure is the number of calendar days before the anniversary bill that the member is notified of the coming settle-up and new installment: 30 on every plan except Levelized Billing Rolling Average, which shows 0.

## Hypothetical dates and amounts

- *Hypothetical:* a settle-up bill dated the 4th of a month is due on the 24th of the same month, 20 calendar days later.
- *Hypothetical:* a Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan settle-up credit of $50.00 is at least the $50.00 minimum, so it is refunded by check; a credit of $49.99 is below it, so it is not refunded by check.
- *Hypothetical:* on Farm Budget Billing an anniversary settle-up debit that the member asks to spread is billed over 3 bills.
